info.archetype.title: BANNER ARCHETYPE
info.archetype.analogy: Banner type = rulebook: each type has its own spark, pity group, and free pulls.
info.archetype.body:
LIMITED — 70% rate-up, spark at 300 pulls, isolated pity, 1 free 10-pull + 14 daily free pulls.

EVENT — 50% rate-up, rate-up guaranteed after 150 pulls, shared pity.

STANDARD — 50% rate-up, no hard pity, shared pity.

CROSSOVER — 100% rate-up, spark at 120 pulls, isolated pity, 1 free 10-pull.

KERNEL — 50% rate-up, no hard pity, kernel shared pity.

Isolated means the inherited pity counter is ignored and starts at 0.
info.archetype.impact: Pity, spark, free pulls, rate-up, and tier status.
info.income.title: INCOME ASSUMPTIONS
info.income.analogy: All income is assumed routine and guaranteed — no events, no random drops.
info.income.body:
Annihilation (1 800 ORU/week) and monthly calendar resets are assumed claimed automatically.

Income is deterministic only: no event rewards, no random drops.
info.leviathan.title: CUSTOM OP PACKS
info.leviathan.analogy: Optional add-on on top of the $500/month basket.
info.leviathan.body:
Optional add-on on top of the $500/month best-value basket. Normal packs only — no first-time bonus.

OP20 is the best filler at 0.400 pulls/$; OP130 is 0.390. Normal packs are unlimited and stack directly.
info.leviathan.impact: Leviathan basket, total pulls, tier price.
info.target-prob.title: P(TARGET | 6★)
info.target-prob.analogy: Layered lottery: getting a 6★ = reaching the final round. This number = your chance of winning that final round once you are there.
info.target-prob.body:
This is a conditional chance: once a 6★ lands, how likely is it your target operator — not the chance of the 6★ itself.

If the banner has two rate-ups splitting 50%, a single target's chance becomes 25%. The 35% default assumes one operator in the rate-up slot.

If the target is ABSENT, this is forced to 0 and Spark is disabled.
info.target-prob.example:
6★ drops average around pull 35.
At 35%, the per-pull target chance is only about 0.7%.
info.target-prob.impact: P(TARGET), PULLS @ CONF, badge, MIN VIABLE TIER.
info.confidence.title: CONFIDENCE TARGET
info.confidence.analogy: An exam target: “want to be 90% sure” means studying until 9 of 10 outcomes pass.
info.confidence.body:
This is a passing line, not a probability. You choose how sure you want to be; the engine calculates the pulls needed.

50% = a coin flip. 90% = the safe default. 95% = near certain, but far more expensive.

Raising confidence does not change the odds; it only raises the pull target.
info.confidence.impact: BENCHMARK, FEASIBLE badge, MIN VIABLE TIER, TIERS CLEARING, advice.
info.mode.title: TARGET MODE
info.mode.analogy: Saving up vs chasing a prize: “do I have enough?” vs “what are my odds?”
info.mode.body:
TARGET PULLS = whether the total pulls you can gather reach the target number (e.g. 300 for Spark).

TARGET POTENTIAL = the chance of getting a certain number of copies before the deadline.

Badges follow the mode: PULLS compares totals; POTENTIAL compares odds against confidence.
info.mode.example:
PULLS 300 → check which tiers reach 300 pulls.
POTENTIAL 90% → check the chance of 1 copy.
info.mode.impact: All badges, benchmark, the second number on tier cards.
info.potential.title: TARGET POTENTIAL
info.potential.analogy: “I want Pot 3” = final target, not number of copies to buy.
info.potential.body:
Target potential level to reach. Copies needed = Target − Current Potential.

Raising the target pushes it further away, so it needs more pulls and a more expensive tier.

If the banner Spark guarantees a copy before the target is met, a tier can be GUARANTEED.
info.potential.example:
Current 0 → target 1 = 1 copy.
Current 1 → target 3 = 2 copies (not 3× pulls).
info.current-potential.title: CURRENT POTENTIAL
info.current-potential.analogy: “I already own 1 dupe” = start from Pot 1, not from zero.
info.current-potential.body:
Pot you already own. Default 0 = operator not owned yet.

Copies still needed = Target Potential − Current Potential (minimum 0).

If current already meets or exceeds target, copies needed = 0 and all tiers are GUARANTEED.
info.current-potential.example:
Current 0, target 3 → needs 3 copies.
Current 1, target 3 → needs 2 copies.
Current 3, target 3 → 0 copies.
info.current-potential.impact: required copies, P(TARGET), PULLS @ CONF, GUARANTEED status.
info.availability.title: TARGET AVAILABILITY
info.availability.analogy: Store shelf: FEATURED = front shelf, OFF_BANNER = warehouse, ABSENT = not sold.
info.availability.body:
FEATURED = target is in the rate-up slot. OFF_BANNER = target is only in the regular 6★ pool.

ABSENT = target is not on the banner. This kills the odds and Spark: every tier drops to 0%.

For FEATURED and OFF_BANNER, the odds still come from P(TARGET | 6★).
info.pity.title: CURRENT PITY
info.pity.analogy: A parking meter: the longer you go without a 6★, the bigger the next 6★ chance.
info.pity.body:
This counts how many pulls in a row have not produced a 6★.

After 49 misses, the 6★ chance slowly rises. The counter resets to 0 whenever a 6★ appears.

LIMITED and CROSSOVER use isolated pity, so this field is hidden and the counter is treated as 0.
info.pity.example: Pity 60 → the next 6★ chance is far above the 2% base.
info.certs.title: YELLOW CERTS + SHOP HEADHUNT PHASE
info.certs.body:
Yellow certs are exchanged for pulls through the shop. The shop has a price ladder: lower phases are cheap, upper phases are expensive.

SHOP HEADHUNT PHASE = the headhunt phase you already bought this month, so it is skipped.

Remaining certs can be used again next month. This model does not add new cert income.
info.certs.example: 180 certs, HH Phase 2 cleared → 21 pulls, 14 certs left.
info.op-pct.title: OP CONVERSION %
info.op-pct.analogy: Currency exchange: 100% = convert all OP; 50% = keep half for skins or Sanity.
info.op-pct.body:
How much Originite Prime you convert into Orundum for pulls.

100% = all OP is used. Lower it if you keep some for skins or Sanity. 0% = no OP goes to pulls.
info.badge.title: TIER STATUS
info.badge.analogy: Delivery status: guaranteed / on promise / likely / failed.
info.badge.body:
GUARANTEED = banner Spark guarantees a copy before the deadline.

FEASIBLE = the target odds reach your chosen confidence.

LIKELY = odds above 50%, but below confidence.

DEFICIT = below 50%.
info.benchmark.title: BENCHMARK
info.benchmark.analogy: Finish line: every tier is compared against this line.
info.benchmark.body:
PULLS mode: benchmark = the target pulls you entered.

POTENTIAL mode: benchmark = minimum pulls to reach your confidence.

Delta on a card = total pulls − benchmark. Positive = surplus, negative = short.
info.benchmark.impact: Card delta, MIN VIABLE TIER, advice.
info.pity-grid.title: FOUR PITY NUMBERS
info.pity-grid.analogy: Four different questions: got one? got the target? sure enough? how many pulls?
info.pity-grid.body:
CHANCE ANY 6★ = chance of seeing any 6★ within this tier's pulls.

CHANCE TARGET COPY = chance of getting at least 1 target copy.

P(REACH x%) = whether the active tier reaches your confidence.

PULLS @ CONF = global minimum pulls for confidence, regardless of tier.

How it is calculated: each pull starts at 2% 6★ chance and rises by 2 points after 49 misses. Every 6★ then has a P(TARGET | 6★) chance to be the target. The engine sums every path exactly (DP), adds spark at 120/300 pulls, then returns the four numbers above.
info.pity-grid.example: F2P 190 pulls: any 6★ 100%, target copy 87.2%, PULLS @ CONF 212.
info.monthly-total.title: MONTHLY VS TOTAL
info.monthly-total.analogy: Monthly salary vs total savings until the goal is reached.
info.monthly-total.body:
pulls/mo = recurring income per month (farming, login, green cert, basket).

total = all pulls until the window ends, including inventory, certs, and one-time archetype bonuses.

Badges use total, not pulls/mo.
info.monthly-total.impact: Perceived speed & price of a tier.
